name: graph-read
body: The behaviour that serves a graph read against the live projection: resolve the reader against `apg/.trans/db.lbug` — opening it read-only, sharing it with the single writer, or routing the read to a live session over the transparent socket — and return the current state. It is what makes read-your-writes hold for a new process and read-access-during-session hold while a session owns the DB.
